metadata.timing: precompute setup is outside transform timing; trace uses jitted_function.trace, lower uses traced.lower, compile uses lowered.compile, and warm is the median of blocking calls
metadata.memory: Linux process peak RSS from resource.getrusage; cumulative within each worker process; JAX device memory_stats when available
metadata.transform_path: ordinary S2FFT JAX transform with external O(L^2) Price-McEwen precomputations
metadata.error: maximum absolute error divided by maximum absolute reference value
